items.performers: Victoria de los Ángeles, Nicolai Gedda, Janine Micheau, Ernest Blanc; French Radio chorus and orchestra; Thomas Beecham
items.label: EMI / Warner Classics
items.note: The two acoustic arias in the Hall introduce Carmen and Escamillo separately. The complete opera supplies José’s Flower Song, the cards and the final duet, where the bullring crowd’s refrain becomes part of a murder scene. Beecham’s set is the first choice for the music’s dancing ease and the tenderness that makes its ending hurt.

items.work: Les Pêcheurs de perles — complete opera
items.performers: Nicolai Gedda; Opéra-Comique chorus and orchestra; Pierre Dervaux
items.label: EMI / Warner Classics
items.note: The friendship duet is only the beginning. Nadir’s romance and the conflict around Leïla need the complete work; Gedda’s elegant line makes Dervaux’s recording a persuasive way into Bizet’s earlier theatre. Warner’s page identifies the complete performance rather than a highlights compilation.
